an5.133:1.1: yopi kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā sopi na arājakaṃ cakkaṃ pavattetīti
an5.133:1.2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.133:1.3: ko pana bhante rañño cakkavattissa dhammikassa dhammarañño rājāti
an5.133:2.1: idha bhikkhu rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā dhammaññeva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati antojanasmiṃ.
an5.133:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā …pe… dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati khattiyesu anuyantesu balakāyasmiṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu
an5.133:3.2: sa kho so bhikkhu rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā …pe… dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahitvā antojanasmiṃ dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahitvā khattiyesu anuyantesu balakāyasmiṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu dhammeneva cakkaṃ pavatteti
an5.133:3.3: taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ kenaci manussabhūtena paccatthikena pāṇinā
an5.133:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhu tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dhammiko dhammarājā dhammaññeva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati bhikkhūsu
an5.133:4.2: evarūpaṃ kāyakammaṃ sevitabbaṃ evarūpaṃ kāyakammaṃ na sevitabbaṃ
an5.133:4.3: evarūpaṃ vacīkammaṃ sevitabbaṃ evarūpaṃ vacīkammaṃ na sevitabbaṃ
an5.133:4.4: evarūpaṃ manokammaṃ sevitabbaṃ evarūpaṃ manokammaṃ na sevitabbaṃ
an5.133:4.5: evarūpo ājīvo sevitabbo evarūpo ājīvo na sevitabbo
an5.133:4.6: evarūpo gāmanigamo sevitabbo evarūpo gāmanigamo na sevitabboti.
an5.133:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dhammiko dhammarājā …pe… dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati bhikkhunīsu … upāsakesu … upāsikāsu
an5.133:5.2: evarūpaṃ kāyakammaṃ sevitabbaṃ evarūpaṃ kāyakammaṃ na sevitabbaṃ
an5.133:5.6: evarūpo gāmanigamo sevitabbo evarūpo gāmanigamo na sevitabboti
an5.133:6.1: sa kho so bhikkhu tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dhammiko dhammarājā …pe… dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahitvā bhikkhūsu dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahitvā bhikkhunīsu … upāsakesu … upāsikāsu dhammeneva anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti
an5.133:6.2: taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
